# Trust

A trust instrument — testamentary or inter vivos. Covers discretionary, bare, life interest, charitable, nil rate band, and offshore structures with governance features (reserved powers, flee clauses, protector powers). Extension types (e.g. x-inherit-waqf) support cultural and jurisdiction-specific trust forms

Source: [`v3/trust.json`](../../v3/trust.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/trust.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this trust within the INHERIT document |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Name of the trust, as it appears in the trust instrument |
| `trustType` | one of `discretionary`, `life_interest`, `bare`, `accumulation_and_maintenance`, `disabled_persons`, `charitable`, `nil_rate_band`, `other`, `residence_nil_rate_band`, `a_b_marital`, `bypass` or `string` | yes | The category of trust. Extension types use x-inherit- prefix (e.g. x-inherit-waqf) |
| `trustees` | array of [TrustAppointee](#def-TrustAppointee) | yes | Persons appointed as trustees, protectors, or enforcers of this trust |
| `beneficiaries` | array of [TrustBeneficiary](#def-TrustBeneficiary) | yes | Beneficiaries of the trust — named individuals, classes, or organisations |
| `settlor` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the settlor (the person who created and funded the trust) |
| `settlorDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced settlor |
| `isTestamentary` | `boolean` | | Whether the trust is created by the will (testamentary) or was established during the settlor's lifetime (inter vivos) |
| `createdAt` | `string` (date-time) | | Timestamp when the trust instrument was executed |
| `creationType` | one of `testamentary`, `inter_vivos_revocable`, `inter_vivos_irrevocable` | | How the trust was created |
| `revocability` | one of `revocable`, `irrevocable`, `perpetual` | | Whether the trust can be revoked, and whether it is perpetual |
| `perpetual` | `boolean` | | Whether the trust is perpetual (has no fixed end date). Waqf endowments and certain offshore trusts are perpetual by nature |
| `vestingAge` | `integer` | | Age at which the beneficiary's interest vests absolutely (for A&M trusts and bare trusts for minors) |
| `vestingDate` | `string` (date) | | Fixed date on which the trust vests, if not age-based |
| `vestingConditions` | array of `string` | | Conditions that must be met for the trust to vest |
| `contingentInterests` | array of `string` | | Interests in the trust that are contingent on future events |
| `trustPeriod` | `string` | | The trust period or perpetuity period, if applicable. In England and Wales, the statutory perpetuity period is 125 years (Perpetuities and Accumulations Act 2009) |
| `governingLaw` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | The jurisdiction whose law governs this trust |
| `reservedPowers` | array of `object` | | Powers reserved by the settlor or granted to a third party. Offshore trusts frequently include reserved powers over investment or distributions |
| `fleeClause` | `object` | | A flee clause allowing automatic or discretionary change of trust situs when triggering events occur. Standard in offshore trust planning |
| `protectorPowers` | array of `object` | | Powers held by the trust protector or enforcer. Offshore trusts commonly use protectors to oversee trustees |
| `jurisdictionalRecognition` | array of `object` | | How different jurisdictions recognise (or fail to recognise) this trust. Critical for cross-border trust structures |
| `assetProtectionFeatures` | `object` | | Asset protection features of the trust. Relevant for Cook Islands, Nevis, BVI, and domestic US asset protection trusts (Delaware, Nevada, South Dakota) |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this trust. Use for trustee succession plans, special investment mandates, or other non-structured information |
| `visibility` | [Visibility](common/visibility.md) | | |
| `trusteePersonIds` | array of `string` (uuid) | | Person IDs of the trustees. A trust may have multiple trustees |
| `conditions` | `string` | | Conditions under which the trust activates, distributes, or terminates. Free text for complex conditions that cannot be fully structured |
| `conditionType` | one of `age_attainment`, `event_based`, `discretionary`, `fixed_date`, `accumulation`, `other` | | Category of the trust's primary activation condition |
| `reviewDate` | `string` (date) | | Next scheduled review date for the trust terms |
| `protectorPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | | Person ID of the trust protector (if appointed). The protector oversees trustees and can modify trust terms |
| `protectorPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced protector person |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `petId` | `string` (uuid) | | If this trust exists for the care of a specific pet, reference to Pet.id |
| `generationSkipping` | `object` | | Generation-skipping transfer classification for US tax purposes (IRC Chapter 13) |
| `letterOfWishesDocumentId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to Document.id containing the letter of wishes for this trust |
| `letterOfWishesStatus` | one of `non_binding`, `morally_binding`, `legally_binding` | | Binding status of the letter of wishes |
| `charitableRemainderDetails` | `object` | | Charitable remainder trust details — income interest to non-charitable beneficiary, remainder to charity |
| `taxPlanningDetails` | `object` | | Tax planning configuration for nil-rate band, RNRB, A/B marital, or bypass trusts |
| `conflictsOfInterest` | array of `object` | | Declared conflicts of interest — executor/trustee who is also a beneficiary, drafter, or family member |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-TrustAppointee"></a>

### TrustAppointee

A person appointed to a governance role in the trust — trustee, protector, or enforcer

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the appointee |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `role` | one of `trustee`, `protector`, `enforcer` | yes | The governance role this person holds in the trust |
| `organisationId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Organisation.id if the trustee is a corporate trustee. Mutually exclusive with personId |
| `organisationIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced organisation |

<a id="def-TrustBeneficiary"></a>

### TrustBeneficiary

A beneficiary of the trust — may be a named individual, a class, or an organisation

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the beneficiary, if a named individual |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `classDefinition` | `string` | | Natural-language description of the beneficiary class |
| `organisationName` | `string` | | Name of the organisation beneficiary |
| `interestType` | one of `income`, `capital`, `both`, `discretionary` | yes | The nature of this beneficiary's interest in the trust |
| `generationLevel` | `integer` | | Generational distance from the testator. 1 = child, 2 = grandchild, 3+ = great-grandchild |
